# Obesity and hypercapnic respiratory failure analysis

## Section 0. Setup

### Load packages

```{r setup-packages}
library(haven)
library(ggplot2)
library(modelsummary)
library(here)
library(gtsummary)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

### Define file paths and constants

```{r define-constants}
data_path <- here::here("full_db.rds")
co2_abg_cutoff <- 45
co2_vbg_cutoff <- 50
ph_cutoff <- 7.35

icd_hrf_vars <- c("has_j9612", "has_j9622", "has_j9692", "has_j9602")

coef_map_common <- c(
  "curr_bmi_num" = "BMI (per 1 kg/m^2)",
  "age_at_encounter" = "Age (per year)",
  "sexMale" = "Male",
  "ethnicityHispanic or Latino" = "Hispanic/Latino",
  "ethnicityUnknown" = "Ethnicity: Unknown"
)
```

## Section 1. Data ingest and harmonization

### `readRDS()`

```{r read-data}
stata_data <- readRDS(data_path)
```

### Standardize types (labelled -> numeric, factors)

```{r standardize-types}
# Verify before conversion
table(stata_data$niv_proc, useNA = "ifany")

# Convert labelled variables to numeric properly
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    niv_proc = case_when(
      as.character(as_factor(niv_proc)) == "Received NIV (not including nightly CPAP)" ~ 1,
      as.character(as_factor(niv_proc)) == "No NIV" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    imv_proc = case_when(
      as.character(as_factor(imv_proc)) == "Received IMV" ~ 1,
      as.character(as_factor(imv_proc)) == "No IMV" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    highest_paco2 = as.numeric(highest_paco2),
    abg_ph = as.numeric(abg_ph),
    vbg_co2 = as.numeric(vbg_co2),
    vbg_ph = as.numeric(vbg_ph)
  )

# Verify after conversion
table(stata_data$niv_proc, useNA = "ifany")

stopifnot(all(is.na(stata_data$niv_proc) | stata_data$niv_proc %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(any(stata_data$niv_proc == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(any(stata_data$niv_proc == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(all(is.na(stata_data$imv_proc) | stata_data$imv_proc %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(any(stata_data$imv_proc == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(any(stata_data$imv_proc == 1, na.rm = TRUE))

any_vent <- (stata_data$niv_proc == 1 | stata_data$imv_proc == 1)
stopifnot(any(any_vent == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(any(any_vent == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Section 2. Variable derivations

### BMI parsing + BMI categories

```{r bmi-parsing-qc}
bmi_raw <- stata_data %>%
  transmute(curr_bmi_raw = na_if(str_trim(as.character(zap_labels(curr_bmi))), "n/a"))

non_numeric_bmi <- bmi_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(curr_bmi_raw), !str_detect(curr_bmi_raw, "^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$"))

non_numeric_bmi %>%
  count(curr_bmi_raw, sort = TRUE)

non_numeric_bmi %>%
  summarise(n_failed_parse = n())
```

```{r derive-bmi}
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    curr_bmi_num = if_else(
      str_detect(str_trim(as.character(zap_labels(curr_bmi))), "^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$"),
      as.numeric(str_trim(as.character(zap_labels(curr_bmi)))),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    bmi_category = case_when(
      is.na(curr_bmi_num) ~ NA_character_,
      curr_bmi_num < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
      curr_bmi_num < 25 ~ "Normal weight",
      curr_bmi_num < 30 ~ "Overweight",
      curr_bmi_num < 35 ~ "Obesity I",
      curr_bmi_num < 40 ~ "Obesity II",
      curr_bmi_num >= 40 ~ "Obesity III"
    )
  )
```

### HRF definition v1 (gases + ventilation)

Below is the first stringent iteration of hypercapnic respiratory failure: CO2 greater than 45 if ABG, 50 if VBG, pH <= 7.35, with either NIV or IMV. ABG and VBG values cannot mix.

```{r hrf-v1}
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    gas_source = case_when(
      !is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph) ~ "ABG",
      TRUE ~ "VBG"
    )
  )

stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    hrf_hypercapnic = case_when(
      # ABG-based HRF
      (niv_proc == 1 | imv_proc == 1) &
        gas_source == "ABG" &
        !is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph) &
        highest_paco2 >= co2_abg_cutoff &
        abg_ph <= ph_cutoff ~ 1,

      # VBG-based HRF
      (niv_proc == 1 | imv_proc == 1) &
        gas_source == "VBG" &
        !is.na(vbg_co2) & !is.na(vbg_ph) &
        vbg_co2 >= co2_vbg_cutoff &
        vbg_ph <= ph_cutoff ~ 1,

      # Explicit non-HRF ONLY if gases exist
      (gas_source == "ABG" & !is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph)) |
        (gas_source == "VBG" & !is.na(vbg_co2) & !is.na(vbg_ph)) ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    hrf_hypercapnic = factor(
      hrf_hypercapnic,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  )
```

*Changed the above from `TRUE ~ 0` to `TRUE ~ NA_real_`.*

### HRF definition v2 (labs + ICD) and v2_strict

Regression done with new definition of hypercapnic respiratory failure: pH and CO2 definition as above, except now including ICD codes instead of ventilation.

```{r hrf-v2}
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Lab-based hypercapnic respiratory failure (ABG or VBG)
    hrf_hypercapnic_labs_v2 = case_when(
      !is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph) &
        highest_paco2 >= co2_abg_cutoff & abg_ph < ph_cutoff ~ 1,
      !is.na(vbg_co2) & !is.na(vbg_ph) &
        vbg_co2 >= co2_vbg_cutoff & vbg_ph < ph_cutoff ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    # ICD-based hypercapnic respiratory failure
    hrf_hypercapnic_icd_v2 = ifelse(
      rowSums(across(all_of(icd_hrf_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0
    ),

    # Final combined HRF definition (labs OR ICD)
    hrf_hypercapnic_v2 = ifelse(
      hrf_hypercapnic_labs_v2 == 1 |
        hrf_hypercapnic_icd_v2 == 1,
      1, 0
    )
  )

stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict = ifelse(
      hrf_hypercapnic_labs_v2 == 1 &
        hrf_hypercapnic_icd_v2 == 1,
      1, 0
    )
  )
```

TODO: consider also restricting non-HRF here rather than in primary analysis cohort.

*Non-HRF group definition (has BMI and gas recorded, just without meeting criteria for HRF):*

```{r non-hrf-definition}
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    has_complete_gas = case_when(
      gas_source == "ABG" ~ !is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph),
      gas_source == "VBG" ~ !is.na(vbg_co2) & !is.na(vbg_ph),
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    non_hrf = case_when(
      has_complete_gas == TRUE & hrf_hypercapnic == "No" ~ 1,
      has_complete_gas == TRUE & hrf_hypercapnic == "Yes" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    non_hrf = factor(
      non_hrf,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("HRF", "Non-HRF")
    )
  )
```

*Separate definition for hypercapnia without acidosis or respiratory failure. Note that this group has not yet been pulled out of the non-HRF group, so these patients are a subgroup of the above group.*

```{r compensated-hypercapnia}
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    compensated_hypercapnia = case_when(
      gas_source == "ABG" &
        !is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph) &
        highest_paco2 >= co2_abg_cutoff &
        abg_ph > ph_cutoff ~ 1,
      gas_source == "VBG" &
        !is.na(vbg_co2) & !is.na(vbg_ph) &
        vbg_co2 >= co2_vbg_cutoff &
        vbg_ph > ph_cutoff ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )
```

## Section 3. Cohort construction and attrition

### Primary analysis cohort (HRF v1)

```{r primary-analysis-cohort}
stata_hrf_analysis <- stata_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(curr_bmi_num),
    (!is.na(highest_paco2) & !is.na(abg_ph)) |
      (!is.na(vbg_co2) & !is.na(vbg_ph))
  )
```

### Strict v2 cohort (sensitivity)

```{r strict-v2-cohort}
stata_hrf_strict_analysis <- stata_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(curr_bmi_num),
    has_complete_gas == TRUE,
    (
      hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict == 1 |
        (
          hrf_hypercapnic_labs_v2 == 0 &
            hrf_hypercapnic_icd_v2 == 0
        )
    )
  )
```

*Secondary cohort: created for a possible secondary analysis. Stratified first by hypercapnia, then defined HRF vs compensated hypercapnia for a third regression.*

```{r hypercapnia-cohort}
stata_data <- stata_data %>%
  mutate(
    hypercapnia_flag = case_when(
      (!is.na(highest_paco2) & highest_paco2 >= co2_abg_cutoff) ~ 1,
      (!is.na(vbg_co2) & vbg_co2 >= co2_vbg_cutoff) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

hypercapnia_cohort <- stata_data %>%
  filter(
    has_complete_gas == TRUE,
    hypercapnia_flag == TRUE
  )

hypercapnia_cohort <- hypercapnia_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    hrf_vs_comp = case_when(
      hrf_hypercapnic == "Yes" ~ 1,
      compensated_hypercapnia == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### Are proportions of hypercapnic respiratory failure (v1) different across BMI categories?

Just out of curiosity ran Chi-square analysis below.

```{r bmi-category-hrf-test}
bmi_hrf_subset <- stata_hrf_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmi_category))

bmi_hrf_summary <- bmi_hrf_subset %>%
  group_by(bmi_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_hrf = sum(hrf_hypercapnic == "Yes"),
    n_no_hrf = sum(hrf_hypercapnic == "No"),
    pct_hrf = round(100 * n_hrf / n_total, 1),
    pct_no_hrf = round(100 * n_no_hrf / n_total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(
    bmi_category,
    levels = c("Underweight", "Normal weight", "Overweight", "Obesity I", "Obesity II", "Obesity III")
  ))

chisq_test <- chisq.test(table(bmi_hrf_subset$bmi_category, bmi_hrf_subset$hrf_hypercapnic))

bmi_hrf_summary
chisq_test$p.value
```

Visualization:

```{r plot-v1-bmi-category, fig-cap="Proportion of hypercapnic respiratory failure by BMI category.", fig-alt="Bar chart showing the percent with hypercapnic respiratory failure for each BMI category."}
# Make sure bmi_category is ordered
bmi_hrf_summary <- bmi_hrf_summary %>%
  mutate(
    bmi_category = factor(
      bmi_category,
      levels = c("Underweight", "Normal weight", "Overweight", "Obesity I", "Obesity II", "Obesity III")
    )
  )

# Plot proportion of HRF by BMI category
ggplot(bmi_hrf_summary, aes(x = bmi_category, y = pct_hrf, fill = bmi_category)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_hrf, "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure by BMI Category",
    x = "BMI Category",
    y = "Percent with HRF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Section 5. Primary inferential model

### Unadjusted (aka simple) regression for outcome 1

Below is regression starting with BMI.

```{r v1-unadjusted-model}
logit_bmi_hrf <- glm(
  hrf_hypercapnic ~ curr_bmi_num,
  data = stata_hrf_analysis,
  family = binomial
)

summary(logit_bmi_hrf)
```

OR shows small increase in risk with BMI, though statistically significant. [BL Edit - odds increased by about 0.02 for each BMI point, e.g., 10 BMI points is about a 20% increase in odds.]

### Adjusted, multivariable regression for outcome 1

Regression done again adjusted for variables NOT influenced by BMI (age, sex, ethnicity included - location appears the same for all entries).

```{r v1-adjusted-model}
baseline_model <- glm(
  hrf_hypercapnic ~ curr_bmi_num + age_at_encounter + sex + ethnicity,
  data = stata_hrf_analysis,
  family = binomial
)

summary(baseline_model)
```

```{r v1-modelsummary}
mods_v1 <- list(
  "HRF v1: unadjusted" = logit_bmi_hrf,
  "HRF v1: adjusted" = baseline_model
)

modelsummary(
  mods_v1,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  statistic = "conf.int",
  coef_map = coef_map_common,
  gof_omit = "RMSE|F|Adj|R2"
)
```

Association appears to be stronger once adjusted.

## Section 6. Sensitivity analyses

### Counts for strict HRF definition (v2_strict)

Number of patients meeting strict definition:

```{r strict-v2-counts}
table(stata_data$hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Unadjusted Logistic Regression for Outcome 2

```{r v2-strict-unadjusted}
model_strict_bmi_unadj <- glm(
  hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict ~ curr_bmi_num,
  family = binomial,
  data = stata_hrf_strict_analysis
)

summary(model_strict_bmi_unadj)
```

### Adjusted, Multivariable Regression for Outcome 2

Then adjusted for age, sex, ethnicity:

```{r v2-strict-adjusted}
baseline_model_strict <- glm(
  hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict ~
    curr_bmi_num +
    age_at_encounter +
    sex +
    ethnicity,
  data = stata_hrf_strict_analysis,
  family = binomial
)

summary(baseline_model_strict)
```

```{r v2-modelsummary}
mods_v2 <- list(
  "HRF v2 strict: unadjusted" = model_strict_bmi_unadj,
  "HRF v2 strict: adjusted" = baseline_model_strict
)

modelsummary(
  mods_v2,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  statistic = "conf.int",
  coef_map = coef_map_common,
  gof_omit = "RMSE|F|Adj|R2"
)
```

```{r all-adjusted-modelsummary}
mods_all <- list(
  "HRF v1 (primary)" = baseline_model,
  "HRF v2_strict (sensitivity)" = baseline_model_strict
)

modelsummary(
  mods_all,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  statistic = "conf.int",
  coef_map = coef_map_common,
  gof_omit = "RMSE|F|Adj|R2"
)
```

```{r all-adjusted-modelplot, fig-cap="Adjusted model estimates for primary and strict sensitivity definitions.", fig-alt="Coefficient plot comparing odds ratios from the primary and strict sensitivity logistic models."}
modelplot(
  mods_all,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  coef_omit = "(Intercept)"
)
```

*Possible third analysis, HRF vs compensated hypercapnia: does elevated BMI correlate with progression to respiratory failure in a population that is already hypercapnic?*

Unadjusted:

```{r hypercapnia-subgroup-unadjusted}
model_hypercapnia_sub <- glm(
  hrf_vs_comp ~ curr_bmi_num,
  data = hypercapnia_cohort,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_hypercapnia_sub)
```

More modest effect but seems to still be statistically significant.

Adjusted:

```{r hypercapnia-subgroup-adjusted}
model_hypercapnia_sub_adj <- glm(
  hrf_vs_comp ~ curr_bmi_num + age_at_encounter + sex + ethnicity,
  data = hypercapnia_cohort,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_hypercapnia_sub_adj)
```

Also holds with adjusted analysis.

### Are proportions of hypercapnic respiratory failure (v2) different across BMI categories?

```{r strict-bmi-category-summary}
# Subset to patients with BMI categories
bmi_hrf_strict_subset <- stata_hrf_strict_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmi_category))

# Summary table by BMI category
bmi_hrf_strict_summary <- bmi_hrf_strict_subset %>%
  group_by(bmi_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_hrf = sum(hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict == 1),
    n_no_hrf = sum(hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict == 0),
    pct_hrf = round(100 * n_hrf / n_total, 1),
    pct_no_hrf = round(100 * n_no_hrf / n_total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(
    bmi_category,
    levels = c("Underweight", "Normal weight", "Overweight", "Obesity I", "Obesity II", "Obesity III")
  ))

# Chi-square test
chisq_test_strict <- chisq.test(table(
  bmi_hrf_strict_subset$bmi_category,
  bmi_hrf_strict_subset$hrf_hypercapnic_v2_strict
))

# View summary table and p-value
bmi_hrf_strict_summary
chisq_test_strict$p.value
```

Visualization:

```{r plot-strict-bmi-category, fig-cap="Proportion of strict hypercapnic respiratory failure by BMI category.", fig-alt="Bar chart showing percent with strict hypercapnic respiratory failure across BMI categories."}
# Make sure bmi_category is ordered
bmi_hrf_strict_summary <- bmi_hrf_strict_summary %>%
  mutate(
    bmi_category = factor(
      bmi_category,
      levels = c("Underweight", "Normal weight", "Overweight", "Obesity I", "Obesity II", "Obesity III")
    )
  )

# Plot proportion of strict HRF by BMI category
ggplot(bmi_hrf_strict_summary, aes(x = bmi_category, y = pct_hrf, fill = bmi_category)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_hrf, "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Strict Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure by BMI Category",
    x = "BMI Category",
    y = "Percent with Strict HRF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Section 7. Population attributable fraction

*This is my first pass at the PAF with the adjusted primary cohort.*

```{r first-pass-paf}
stata_hrf_analysis$pred_obs <- predict(baseline_model, type = "response")
risk_observed <- mean(stata_hrf_analysis$pred_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_observed

stata_cf <- stata_hrf_analysis
stata_cf$curr_bmi_num <- 25
stata_cf$pred_cf <- predict(baseline_model, newdata = stata_cf, type = "response")
risk_counterfactual <- mean(stata_cf$pred_cf, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_counterfactual

paf <- (risk_observed - risk_counterfactual) / risk_observed
paf
```
